rules.name: xoga754-01-neovest-output-pattern-dev
rules.sql: SELECT c.uuid, c.tenant_id, c.template_name, c.code, c.status, c.rule_data -> 'workflowConfig' -> 'output' AS output_block, c.rule_data -> 'workflowConfig' ->> 'workFlowName' AS wf_name, (SELECT string_agg(m[1], ' | ') FROM regexp_matches(c.rule_data::text, '"([^"]*neovestBuName[^"]*)"', 'g') AS m) AS neovest_patterns, length(c.rule_data::text) AS rule_bytes, md5(c.rule_data::text) AS rule_md5 FROM opera.oga_configservice_uploadrules c WHERE c.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND c.template_name IN ('Neovest') ORDER BY c.created_timestamp

expect.reason: Neovest rows (2 expected: fields row and workflowConfig row)
